DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS: The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Plans withstanding planning permission ref. P2025/0520/FUL:
•	P-2428-000 Location Plan
•	P-2428-101 Rev B Proposed Ground Floor Plan
•	P-2428-102 Rev B Proposed Ground Floor Plan & External Area 
•	P-2428-111 Proposed Section AA
•	P-2428-112 Proposed Section BB
•	Proposed Glazing Details -2428-120
•	Proposed Glazing Details -2428-121
•	Proposed Glazing Details P 2428-122
•	Design, Access, Impact & Heritage Statement by Fallon Architects dated February 2024
•	Sustainable Design & Construction Statement by Fallon Architects dated March 2025

New S73 Plans:
•	P-2428-103 Revision A Proposed First Floor Plan
•	P-2428-104 A Proposed Second Floor Plan
•	P-2428-105 Revision A Proposed Third Floor Plan (Lower Level)
•	P-2428-106 Revision A Proposed Third Floor Plan (Upper Level)
•	P-2428-107 Revision A Proposed Roof Plan
•	P-2428-108 Revision C Proposed Front Elevation & Proposed Rear Elevation
•	P-2428-110 Revision A Proposed Side (north) Elevation
•	P-2428-113 Revision C Proposed Section CC
•	Sustainable Design & Construction Statement dated Sept 2026

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description: Variation of condition 2 (drawings) of planning planning ref: P2025/0520/FUL dated 21/05/2025  for 'Proposed ground floor side return and rear extension, dormer extension to rear roof slope with rooflight, replacement tiled roof, replacement windows with double glazing, landscaping to rear garden including lowering garden level and extending boundary wall with relocation of gate' to raise boundary wall of side extension by 330mm to form gutter and remove UPVC eaves gutter.
